Borac Banja Luka is one of the more popular football clubs in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The name ''Borac'' means "Fighter". Currently, Borac is a part of the [[Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina]] and plays its home matches at the [[Banja Luka City Stadium]], which has a capacity of 10,030 seats."}}
